data.narrative:
Primoco UAV is a publicly traded Defense & Security company founded by Ladislav Semetkovský, with €44M+ in orderbook backing. The valuation universe comprises 23 same-sector peers: 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 identifiable private competitors including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median valuation analysis is not applicable here. The Defense & Security sector lacks sufficient narrow-stage peer density—only 1 same-stage comparable was identified, with zero adjacent-stage and zero similar-tier private matches. The threshold for reliable peer multiples requires a minimum of 3 datapoints; expanding to all 23 same-sector peers would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity in stage, technology maturity, and revenue scale, rendering cross-sectional multiples misleading rather than instructive.

The analysis therefore cannot triangulate a valuation range using standard peer methodology. A defensible valuation would require either: (1) revenue or EBITDA-based DCF modeling using company-specific growth and margin assumptions; (2) transaction comps from the narrower UAV/drone defense subsector; or (3) detailed comparable public trading multiples (EV/revenue, EV/EBITDA) from the two public peers, adjusted for Primoco's specific stage, addressable market penetration, and orderbook conversion risk. Without these quantitative inputs, no supported valuation range can be synthesized.
